title: Unsupported kwargs passed to http.parse_cookie
detail: The function forwards all kwargs (including 'cls') to werkzeug.http.parse_cookie, which does not accept a 'cls' parameter. This will raise a TypeError when a caller supplies 'cls', breaking cookie parsing in request handling.

title: Inverted file pointer check
detail: The condition skips processing when fp is not None, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. It should skip only when fp is None to avoid errors when reading from a file-like object.

title: Unprotected import of cryptography
detail: The import of cryptography (and OpenSSL) is performed unconditionally inside an else block without a try/except. If these packages are not installed, ImportError will be raised at runtime, breaking the module import.

title: Breakpoint update logic only runs when both horizontal and vertical breakpoints are present
detail: The condition `if horizontal_breakpoints and vertical_breakpoints:` prevents breakpoint updates when only one type of breakpoint is defined, causing style updates to be skipped on resize events that only affect one dimension.

title: Uncaught ImportError in vendor module lookup
detail: The function uses importlib.import_module to load a vendored module but does not catch ImportError. If the module name is invalid or missing, the import will raise an exception that propagates to callers, potentially crashing the debug command or the type‑checking process.
note: Only pip's own vendored modules are imported here.
